hero.emptyIncome: Set up your income to see how much you have available.
hero.availableHint: Net income − fixed expenses − variable spending − debt payments.

hint.netIncome: Net salary (after withholding) plus other income prorated per month.
hint.dti: Debt payments ÷ gross monthly income. Above 36% is risky.

insight.projection: At this pace you would accumulate {amount} in 12 months ({monthly}/mo).
insight.flow: Your cumulative cash flow would reach {amount} in 12 months.

savingsGap.title: Savings gap
savingsGap.notViable: With your current expenses and debts, the savings rule is not viable this month.

empty.donut: Set up income and allocation to see this chart.
empty.projection: Set up your finances to see the projection.

breakdown.emergencyHint: Emergency reserve: cash + savings + investments ÷ monthly outflow (fixed + variable + debt). Different from the runway months.

ideal.dti: Ideal: debt payments ≤ 20% of gross income
ideal.emergency: Ideal: 6 or more months of spending covered
ideal.savings: Ideal: save 20% or more of net income

error.title: Save failed
error.quotaExceeded: Browser storage is full. Your data is still in memory but won't be saved until space is freed.
error.invalidState: In-memory data is invalid. Retry or review the form.

savings.noRateConfigured: Set an annual rate on a savings or investment asset to see the compound growth projection.

projection.rateHint: Return assumption for the dashboard compound curve.
projection.hintNeedRate: Enter a rate above 0% to see the compound projection.
projection.hintNeedAssets: Add liquid net worth (cash, savings, or investment) to project growth.
projection.assumptions: Starts from {liquid} in liquid assets and adds {monthly} per month (the saving that fits the rule and your budget).

annualRatePercent.label: Annual rate (EAR %)
annualRatePercent.hint: Effective Annual Rate between 0% and 100%. Applies to savings and investment assets.

apr.label: Effective Annual Rate (EAR)
apr.tooltip: APR here means Effective Annual Rate, the Colombian Superfinanciera standard. Monthly rate uses (1 + EAR)^(1/12) − 1.

summary.title: Debt-free
summary.never: Some debts would never be paid off: the monthly payment does not cover the interest.
summary.totalInterest: Interest left to pay at current payments: {amount}

simulator.title: Extra payment simulator
simulator.cardsOnly: Simulator applies to credit cards only.

runway.title: Months of runway
runway.hint: How many months your liquid money would cover spending and debt payments if income stopped.

flowCoverage.title: Flow coverage
flowCoverage.covered: Expenses covered by passive and residual income
flowCoverage.hint: Share of your living costs paid by passive or residual income (rent, dividends, royalties).

retencion.title: Withholding tax (estimated)
retencion.notApplicable: Does not apply at this salary level.
retencion.manual: You already entered a withholding deduction; it is not subtracted twice.
retencion.hint: Uses the {year} UVT, health, pension and solidarity fund contributions, and the 25% exempt income (capped at 790 UVT per year).

detail.title: Financial freedom
detail.subtitle: Financial independence target (25× annual living expenses)
detail.noFeasibleSavings: Without feasible monthly savings, a horizon cannot be estimated.
detail.assumptions: Assumes you save {monthly} per month (your feasible saving), with no returns or inflation. Target = 25 × annual spending (4% rule).

history.title: History
history.empty: No month closes yet. The first one is saved automatically when next month starts.

variable.title: Variable spending
variable.empty: Create a category (groceries, restaurants, transport…) to log this month's spending.
variable.resetHint: Spending resets automatically each month; the closed month is kept in the history.

card.behind: At this pace you finish in {date}, after your target date. You need {amount} per month.
card.noContrib: Without a monthly contribution there is no estimate.
